# `codespec`

Generated by `codespec-docs` from the clap definition in [`crates/cli/src/lib.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/blob/main/crates/cli/src/lib.rs). It lists only commands that exist. `codespec --version` prints the version, and `--help` after any command prints the same text.

> Read code into cir/1, check it, write code from it

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`codespec validate`](#codespec-validate) | Validate a cir/1 document; with --canonical, also require its canonical encoding |
| [`codespec schema`](#codespec-schema) | Print the JSON Schema of cir/1 |
| [`codespec features`](#codespec-features) | Print the cir/1 feature vocabulary (codespec-features/1): every feature id an adapter can support, sorted by id |
| [`codespec read`](#codespec-read) | Run the reader adapter for LANG over SOURCE and write the validated cir/1 module to OUT |
| [`codespec pass`](#codespec-pass) | Apply every pass (lookup-guard, then the facts) to a cir/1 module and write the result to OUT |
| [`codespec write`](#codespec-write) | Validate a cir/1 module and run the writer adapter for LANG, writing into OUT |
| [`codespec conform`](#codespec-conform) | Run the conformance kit against the adapter codespec-ROLE-LANG, by the claim its --describe manifest prints, and write a codespec-conformance-report/1 to OUT; exit 1 when it does not conform. With --check REPORT, run again for the report's adapter and exit 1 naming every feature whose entry differs |
| [`codespec harness`](#codespec-harness) | Build every implementation EXAMPLE/harness.toml lists, run each on one generated trace per seed and require byte-equal output; exit 1 naming the seed, implementation and first differing line otherwise |

## `codespec validate`

Validate a cir/1 document; with --canonical, also require its canonical encoding

```text
Usage: codespec validate [OPTIONS] <FILE>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Environment | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<FILE>` | yes | none | none | The cir/1 document to read. |
| `--canonical` | no | none | none | Also require the file's bytes to be the document's canonical encoding. |

## `codespec schema`

Print the JSON Schema of cir/1

```text
Usage: codespec schema
```

## `codespec features`

Print the cir/1 feature vocabulary (codespec-features/1): every feature id an adapter can support, sorted by id

```text
Usage: codespec features
```

## `codespec read`

Run the reader adapter for LANG over SOURCE and write the validated cir/1 module to OUT

```text
Usage: codespec read --lang <LANG> --out <OUT> --adapters <ADAPTERS> <SOURCE>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Environment | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--lang <LANG>` | yes | none | none | The source language; selects the adapter `codespec-read-<lang>`. |
| `<SOURCE>` | yes | none | none | The source the adapter reads: for Go, one package directory. |
| `--out <OUT>` | yes | none | none | Where the validated cir/1 module is written, in canonical encoding. |
| `--adapters <ADAPTERS>` | yes | none | `CODESPEC_ADAPTERS` | Directory holding the adapter programs `codespec-read-<lang>` and `codespec-write-<lang>`. |

## `codespec pass`

Apply every pass (lookup-guard, then the facts) to a cir/1 module and write the result to OUT

```text
Usage: codespec pass --out <OUT> <FILE>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Environment | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<FILE>` | yes | none | none | The cir/1 module to rewrite. |
| `--out <OUT>` | yes | none | none | Where the rewritten module is written, in canonical encoding. |

## `codespec write`

Validate a cir/1 module and run the writer adapter for LANG, writing into OUT

```text
Usage: codespec write --lang <LANG> --out <OUT> --adapters <ADAPTERS> <FILE>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Environment | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--lang <LANG>` | yes | none | none | The target language; selects the adapter `codespec-write-<lang>`. |
| `<FILE>` | yes | none | none | The cir/1 module to write. |
| `--out <OUT>` | yes | none | none | The directory the adapter writes into. |
| `--adapters <ADAPTERS>` | yes | none | `CODESPEC_ADAPTERS` | Directory holding the adapter programs `codespec-read-<lang>` and `codespec-write-<lang>`. |

## `codespec conform`

Run the conformance kit against the adapter codespec-ROLE-LANG, by the claim its --describe manifest prints, and write a codespec-conformance-report/1 to OUT; exit 1 when it does not conform. With --check REPORT, run again for the report's adapter and exit 1 naming every feature whose entry differs

```text
Usage: codespec conform [OPTIONS] --adapters <ADAPTERS>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Environment | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--lang <LANG>` | no | none | none | The adapter's language; selects codespec-ROLE-LANG and the runner codespec-run-LANG. |
| `--role <ROLE>` | no | none | none | reader or writer. |
| `--out <OUT>` | no | none | none | Where the report is written. |
| `--check <CHECK>` | no | none | none | A report to check: run again and compare. |
| `--kit <KIT>` | no | `conformance` | none | The kit directory: kit.json and cases/. |
| `--corpus <CORPUS>` | no | none | none | A reader's corpus: one directory per kit case, its source and calls.json. Defaults to KIT/reader/LANG. |
| `--adapters <ADAPTERS>` | yes | none | `CODESPEC_ADAPTERS` | Directory holding the adapter, its runner and, for a reader, codespec-write-go and codespec-run-go. |
| `--work <WORK>` | no | none | none | Where each case is written, read and built; emptied first. Defaults to target/conform/ROLE-LANG. |
| `--timeout <TIMEOUT>` | no | `300` | none | Seconds one program (adapter, runner) may run before it is killed and the case recorded as `timeout`. |

## `codespec harness`

Build every implementation EXAMPLE/harness.toml lists, run each on one generated trace per seed and require byte-equal output; exit 1 naming the seed, implementation and first differing line otherwise

```text
Usage: codespec harness [OPTIONS] <EXAMPLE>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Environment | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<EXAMPLE>` | yes | none | none | The example directory holding harness.toml. |
| `--seeds <SEEDS>` | no | `200` | none | How many seeds, 0 to SEEDS-1, each giving one trace. |
| `--commands <COMMANDS>` | no | `300` | none | Commands per trace. |
| `--build-dir <BUILD_DIR>` | no | `target/harness` | none | Directory the implementations are built into; `{build}` in harness.toml. |

## Exit status

0 on success. 1 when a document is refused (unknown field, unknown kind, an untyped expression, another format, not canonical under `--canonical`), when an adapter is missing, exits non-zero or prints a document the model refuses, and when the harness finds a difference; the reason is printed on stderr as `codespec: <reason>`. Clap's own usage errors exit 2.
